response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, workshops on testing), and exceeds the 8-year development experience bar. However, this is a people-management role requiring 2+ years of formal people management and 3+ years of technical leadership over teams, and the resume shows no direct reports, no performance-management experience, and no organizational-change leadership. Mobile experience is limited to one iOS/Apple TV stint a decade ago. He would be a better fit for a senior/staff IC role on this team than for the manager position.
strengths: Authentic developer-tools background: authored test runners (Trial), assertion libraries (Fluent-Asserts), and built CI/GitLab/deployment infrastructure
20 years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, backend, and embedded systems
Demonstrated teaching and mentorship inclination via workshops, courses, and community talks
concerns: No formal people-management experience — no evidence of direct reports, one-on-ones, or performance management
No demonstrated experience leading organizational change or setting team-level roadmaps in a management capacity
Mobile-platform experience is dated (2015–2016) and shallow relative to the role's mobile ecosystem focus

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
